name: Andrew Shakes
story: John Thyne, Byron Cochrane and Richard Wells had stood down; Derrick Williams, Andrew Shakes, Nenad Petrovic and Kurt Janssen were nominated and elected unopposed, while Marie Slako, Tony Standen, Rachel Summers and Richard Sisterson were reconfirmed. The November 2010 minutes use the name “New Zealand ESRI Users Group inc.”
